# Switch: `jl-switch`

An on/off setting that applies at once.

- Class `JlSwitch`, an atom: `import { JlSwitch } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/switch

An on/off setting that applies as soon as it flips: dark mode, notifications, a feature flag. For a
choice that a button confirms later, prefer a checkbox.

Screen readers announce it as a switch, on or off. In a form, the form gets its value ("on" unless set) while it is
on, and nothing while it is off, as with a checkbox.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSwitch } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSwitch checked label="Dark mode" />
```

```html
<jl-switch checked label="Dark mode"></jl-switch>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `checked` (attribute `checked`): `boolean`, default `false`. Whether it is on. The attribute is also what a form reset goes back to.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The text beside the switch.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A smaller line under the label.
- `hideLabel` (attribute `hide-label`): `boolean`, default `false`. Keeps the label for screen readers only, when the page already shows what the switch means beside it.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md'`, default `'md'`. The size of the track.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `'on'`. What the form gets while it is on.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `boolean`: Someone turned it on or off.

## Slots

- The default slot: A richer label, with a link or emphasis.

## Methods

- `toggle(): void`: Flips the state, as a click would, and fires change.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the switch.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The label around the switch and its text.
- `--track-width` (custom property): The track width (36px, 28px when small).
- `--track-height` (custom property): The track height (20px, 16px when small).
- `--thumb` (custom property): The thumb size (14px, 10px when small).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### States

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-switch label="Off"></jl-switch>
  <jl-switch label="On" checked></jl-switch>
  <jl-switch label="Disabled" disabled></jl-switch>
  <jl-switch label="Disabled and on" disabled checked></jl-switch>
</div>
```

### Sizes

sm for dense panels and table rows.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-switch size="sm" label="Small" checked></jl-switch>
  <jl-switch label="Medium" checked></jl-switch>
</div>
```

### With a description

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-switch
    label="Deploy previews"
    description="Build every pull request and post a link to it."
    checked
  ></jl-switch>
  <jl-switch
    label="Protect the main branch"
    description="Changes need a review before they merge."
  ></jl-switch>
</div>
```

### A label for screen readers only

The page says the state beside the track; the label still names the switch for screen readers.

```html
<div class="row">
  <span class="muted">On</span>
  <jl-switch label="Workflow on" hide-label checked></jl-switch>
</div>
```

### Listening

The status follows the switch: it listens to change.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-switch class="demo-live" label="Maintenance mode"></jl-switch>
  <jl-badge class="demo-status" label="Live" tone="ok" dot></jl-badge>
</div>
```

```js
const toggle = root.querySelector('.demo-live');
const status = root.querySelector('.demo-status');
toggle.events.register('change', (on) => {
  status.label.set(on ? 'Paused' : 'Live');
  status.tone.set(on ? 'warn' : 'ok');
});
```
